has capacity

  • CURIE: gmeow:hasCapacity
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasCapacity
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places

Links a location to a capacity measurement describing the maximum number of entities it can hold. Flat form for the common case; promote to full reified Capacity when vantage, confidence, temporal scope, or standpoint matter.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Location -> gmeow:Capacity

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:hasCapacity from gmeow:Location to gmeow:Capacity when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
